title: Representative mp-weixin application profile / 代表性 mp-weixin 应用 profile
description: Selects one local source, bounded initial paging, and registered presentation blocks for the neutral representative slice. / 为中性代表性纵切选择一个本地数据源、受限初始分页与已登记呈现区块。

profileVersion.description: Application-profile contract version. / 应用 profile 契约版本。

id.description: Stable identity of this representative application profile. / 本代表性应用 profile 的稳定标识。

sourceMode.description: Explicit local provider mode; no fallback is permitted. / 明确的本地 provider 模式；不允许回退。

page.description: Initial one-based canonical page. / 从一开始的规范化初始页码。

pageSize.description: Initial canonical page size from a deterministic allowlist. / 从确定性白名单选择的规范化初始每页数量。

enabledBlocks.description: Unique compiled block identifiers; values never become component imports. / 无重复的已编译区块标识；其值绝不成为组件导入。

blockOrder.description: A duplicate-free complete order of the enabled compiled block IDs; it never names components, templates, styles, URLs, or expressions. / enabled 的已编译区块标识的无重复完整排序；它绝不指定组件、模板、样式、URL 或表达式。
